pages.title: Investors

intro.heading: Invest alongside *SIRA GROUP.*
intro.standfirst: We partner with institutional and private investors seeking exposure to high-growth real estate and healthcare across Africa, Europe and the Middle East.

pages.content:
Introduction

Tell us who you are and what you are looking for. We reply within two working days and arrange a first conversation with the partner closest to your interest.

The pack

You receive the current investor pack: the group's structure, the opportunities open today, their stage, ticket size and timeline, and how each is governed.

Diligence

Full access to the data room for the opportunity you choose — the operating company, the asset, the counterparties and the audited numbers — together with site visits where they help.

Structure

Each opportunity is structured as a direct equity participation alongside SIRA GROUP, with the group as developer or operator. Terms are agreed before capital is called.

Reporting

Quarterly reporting on every position, an annual review, and a direct line to the partner responsible for the asset for as long as you hold it.

projects.title: Sira Prime
projects.subtitle: Residential
projects.excerpt: Flagship villa development with pre-sales underway.
projects.content:
Sira Prime is a low-rise residential community on Istanbul's Asian shore: 64 villas set around a shared garden spine, with a private clubhouse, a wellness building and direct access to the coastal path.

Pre-sales opened in the second quarter of 2026 and the first phase is scheduled for handover in early 2028. The project is structured as an equity partnership, with SIRA Real Estate as developer and operator of the completed estate.

projects.title: Rosina Diagnostic Center
projects.subtitle: Diagnostic imaging
projects.excerpt: Advanced imaging and molecular diagnostics platform.
projects.content:
Rosina is SIRA Healthcare's flagship centre: MRI, CT, ultrasound and, since July 2026, a PET-CT molecular imaging wing for early-stage cancer diagnostics.

The centre runs on the group's own facility-management system, which schedules modalities, tracks consumables and reports to referring clinicians in real time. It performs more than thirty thousand scans a year and grew 42% year on year.

projects.title: Hospitality Platform
projects.subtitle: Hospitality
projects.excerpt: Founding-partner opportunity in the group's newest hospitality division.
projects.content:
SIRA Lifestyle's first platform brings together branded residences and a boutique hospitality operator across two coastal sites now in review.

The division launched in 2026 and is open to a small number of founding partners who take a position across the platform rather than a single asset.

projects.title: PET-CT Imaging Center
projects.subtitle: Molecular imaging
projects.excerpt: Next-generation molecular imaging for early cancer diagnosis.
projects.content:
A stand-alone molecular imaging centre replicating the Rosina PET-CT wing in a second East African city, with a regional cyclotron partnership for isotope supply.

The centre is the first step of the diagnostic network expansion: the same operating system, the same clinical protocols and the same referral relationships, opened where the demand for advanced imaging is furthest from supply.

projects.title: Istanbul Financial District Advisory
projects.subtitle: Advisory
projects.excerpt: Structuring East African healthcare and housing capital through Istanbul.
projects.content:
An ongoing advisory mandate structuring Turkish and Gulf capital into East African diagnostic and residential platforms, using Istanbul's financial district as the bridge jurisdiction.

SIRA Consulting leads the mandate from Istanbul with the group's own operating companies as reference cases: the structures that carried Rosina and Sira Prime, applied for partners who want the corridor without building it themselves.

projects.title: Coastal Residences
projects.subtitle: Branded residences
projects.excerpt: Branded residences on the Bosphorus approach, operated with SIRA Lifestyle.
projects.content:
A second-phase site adjoining Sira Prime, planned as branded residences with a hospitality operator from the group's own Lifestyle division.

The masterplan follows the Sira Prime brief — low, long and open to the water — and adds a residents' club run by the operator, so that the estate is managed as a hospitality asset from the first day of occupation.
